decisions.reason: the freezer would change without an announcement (a B-signed BALLAST/1|watchers remark >= K = 5 blocks earlier)
announced at #8951, 0 blocks ago < K = 5: too early
freezer -> the watchers set announced by B at 8951-2 (t=1, 3 members), 5 >= K = 5 blocks ago
admin -> the admins set announced by B at 8959-2 (t=2, 3 members), 5 >= K = 5 blocks ago
reserves unreadable: finalized: no provider answered a finalized reading; wind-down branch: 1 of 2 holders with a balance are not individually frozen
wind-down: final r=0.7000 posted by B at 8985-2, 7 >= W = 5 blocks after the freeze, all 2 holders with a balance individually frozen
redeem: 9004-2 by the holder, final r=0.7000 posted by B at 8985-2; burn 30000000 and release r x amount = 21000000 to 0x90F79bf6EB2c4f870365E785982E1f101E93b906

overrides.basis: drill overrides; production K = 3 x H blocks, W ~ 24 h
overrides.providers: one local anvil under two URLs (anvil-a 127.0.0.1, anvil-b localhost)

steps.name: funder tops up the accounts below their working balance
A creates scratch asset 3001
set_metadata pUSDC-gov (6 decimals)
A mints 30.00 to the judge (scratch S1, before the team hand-over)
A mints 20.00 to the peer (scratch S1, before the team hand-over)
A hands the team over: issuer M_mint, admin M_admin, freezer M_watch {W1, W2}
A transfers ownership to M_mint
A proposes set_team(freezer = M_watch' {W1, W2, W3}) through M_mint
B announces the watcher set {W1, W2, W3} 1-of-3 (BALLAST/1|watchers)
bot co-signs (cosign-team --announcement (after K))
W1 tries to freeze through the OLD M_watch {W1, W2}
B announces the admin set {A, A3, B} 2-of-3 (A2 retired; BALLAST/1|admins)
A proposes set_team(admin = M_admin' {A, A3, B}) through M_mint
bot co-signs (cosign-team --announcement (admins, after K))
W3 (community watcher) freezes through M_watch' once every provider reads short at one block
judge transfers 1.00 while the asset is frozen
W3 freezes the judge's account through M_watch' (wind-down step 1)
B posts final r = 70.00 / 100.00 = 0.7000 (BALLAST/1|final)
A proposes thaw_asset through M_admin'
W3 freezes the peer's account through M_watch' (wind-down step 1)
bot co-signs (cosign-thaw --final (all holders frozen))
judge transfers 1.00 after the thaw (account still frozen)
judge asks first: BALLAST/1|redeem with its EVM address
A proposes batch_all([thaw(judge), burn(judge, 30.00)]) through M_admin'
bot co-signs (cosign_redeem)

evm_steps.name: custodian releases r x 30.00 = 21.00 to the judge's EVM address, redeemId = redeem_id(9004-2)

asset live after the wind-down thaw

community watcher after the thaw: deficit but winddown-hold, no freeze (exit 4)
the redemption executed atomically: Thawed + Burned in one extrinsic
after the redemption: S1, reserves, and r unchanged
the judge's EVM address received r x 30.00
